title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 451 (Punishment in case of repeated default)

content.overview: Where a company or an officer commits a second or subsequent default of the same provision within three years, the penalty is twice the penalty provided for that default.
content.glance: Where a company or an officer commits a second or subsequent default of the same provision within three years, the penalty is twice the penalty provided for that default.
content.study: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 451 (Punishment in case of repeated default). Where a company or an officer commits a second or subsequent default of the same provision within three years, the penalty is twice the penalty provided for that default.
